children: NYSE has partnered with Blockchain.com for 24/7/365 trading of tokenized securities.

According to the memorandum of understanding outlining a distribution plan, Blockchain.com's user base can access tokenized U.S. exchange-listed equities and ETFs on NYSE's digital alternative trading system.
NYSE seeks to broaden its access to crypto-native investors through Blockchain.com's global customer base.

"Tokenized stocks are one of the most impactful advancements in the modern financial landscape, and a key catalyst for greater economic freedom," said Blockchain.com CEO Peter Smith. "Connecting to the NYSE digital ATS will enable us to extend the opportunity to invest in these digital assets to tens of millions of Blockchain.com users around the world."

"The future of capital markets belongs to institutions that unite the trust of traditional finance with the innovation and accessibility of digital assets," said NYSE President Lynn Martin. "Blockchain.com's international footprint and digital asset expertise make it a natural complement to our tokenized securities platform upon launch."

title: NYSE, Blockchain.com partner for 24/7/365 trading of tokenized securities
